topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and progression
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section introduces the lecture's learning objectives, the timeline of tumor progression, and the framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in signaling cascades such as Wnt/APC/beta-catenin and receptor tyrosine kinases drive sustained proliferative signaling and cell survival.

topics.label: Blocks in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells fail to undergo normal terminal differentiation in hematopoiesis and colonic epithelial tissues.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how cancer cells avoid programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and imbalances between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Replicative immortalization, telomeres, and senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how telomere shortening and stress responses induce senescence, how cancers reactivate TERT to achieve replicative immortality, and summarize the growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and metabolic rewiring
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific metabolic adaptations, and how mutations in metabolic genes produce oncometabolites that alter the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic discusses how tumors trigger blood vessel growth through a balance of angiogenic activators and inhibitors to supply nutrients and oxygen.

topics.label: Mechanisms and genomics of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the multi-step cascade of metastatic dissemination, the inefficiencies and seed-and-soil dynamics of colonization, and genomic findings from metastatic sequencing.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section provides concluding takeaways on the collective emergence of cancer hallmarks and recommends further reading.
